lonStrDom2_description: potassium voltage-gated channel subfamily C member 1
evidence: NCBI labels it KCNC1, but a separate true KCNC1 exists (96% to human KCNC1). LOC110481261 is the 4th KCNC: 68% to human KCNC3 (best by alignment score), 72.5% to KCNC1. Neighbours GYS1, RUVBL2, PNKP, KCNA7, SNRNP70 are all human 19q13.33 (the KCNC3 locus). RUVBL2/PNKP/KCNA7/SNRNP70 share its scaffold in lonStrDom2. Expression ~0 in every cluster.
